faq-1-1-v: How far is Hotel Asteria from Thermaalbad Arcen?
faq-1-1-a: 23 minutes by car, about 24 kilometres. The hotel is at Maasheseweg 80a in Venray, right on the A73.
faq-1-2-v: Is Hotel Asteria part of Thermaalbad Arcen?
faq-1-2-a: No. Hotel Asteria is an independent hotel in Venray and is not part of Thermaalbad Arcen. Tickets for the thermal baths are sold by Thermaalbad Arcen itself.
faq-1-3-v: What else is there to do near Arcen?
faq-1-3-a: The castle gardens Kasteeltuinen Arcen, the Hertog Jan brewery and De Maasduinen National Park are 21 to 25 minutes from the hotel.
faq-2-1-v: Does the hotel have its own wellness area?
faq-2-1-a: Yes, at the top of the building: 300 m² with four saunas, a steam cabin and a plunge and herbal bath. Hotel guests pay € 12.50 per person. In the wellness package and the winter package the wellness area is included.
faq-2-2-v: When is the wellness area open?
faq-2-2-a: Monday to Thursday from 4 pm to 10 pm, Friday to Sunday from 12 noon to 10 pm. Reserve your time in advance at reception. On request we switch the saunas on earlier for you.
faq-2-3-v: Can I park and charge my car at the hotel?
faq-2-3-a: Yes. Parking at the hotel is free, right on the A73 (exit 8, Venray-Noord). There are four charging points for electric cars and a locked bike shed for your bicycle.
